purpose: Verify Indenter can track the status and history of submitted bookings.
preconditions: Indenter has submitted one or more booking requisitions.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with list containing indenter bookings and their current status.

purpose: Verify Indenter can view detailed booking and confirmation info for submitted booking.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with booking details including reference, dates, and visitor info.

purpose: Verify Indenter booking detail contains printable confirmation information.
action_or_input: Indenter queries booking detail for printing confirmation.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with complete confirmation data suitable for print view.

purpose: Verify unauthenticated visitors cannot access VHMS endpoints directly.
preconditions: No valid session or token provided.
expected_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized refusal.

purpose: Verify Indenter can submit an online booking request using standardized form.
action_or_input: POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/ with complete valid requisition payload.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with booking_reference and status pending.

purpose: Verify visitor details are recorded in each booking requisition.
preconditions: Requisition submitted with visitor name, email, phone.
expected_result: VisitorDetail record created and associated with booking.

purpose: Verify visit purpose is recorded in booking requisition.
expected_result: Booking instance has recorded visit_purpose.

purpose: Verify visitor category (A, B, C, D) is recorded in requisition.
expected_result: Booking instance has visitor_category=B.

purpose: Verify stay duration and timings (arrival and departure dates) are recorded.
expected_result: Booking instance records exact arrival and departure dates.

purpose: Verify number of rooms and number of occupants are recorded in requisition.
expected_result: Booking created with number_of_rooms=2 and number_of_occupants=3.

purpose: Verify billing responsibility is recorded in booking requisition.
expected_result: Booking created with billing_responsibility=institute.

purpose: Verify permitted billing responsibility values (visitor, indenter, institute, project).
preconditions: Indenter submits booking with permitted billing responsibility.
action_or_input: POST with billing_responsibility in [visitor, indenter, institute, project].
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created.

purpose: Verify rejection of unpermitted billing responsibility value.
preconditions: Indenter submits booking with invalid billing responsibility.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify booking status is set to Pending upon submission.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with status=pending.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can review submitted pending booking requests.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK containing pending booking.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can check room availability for date range.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with available room count and room details.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can directly reject a booking request.
action_or_input: Caretaker sends POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/{id}/route/ with action=reject and reason.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=rejected.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can forward eligible booking request to VH In-Charge.
preconditions: Pending booking exists with available rooms.
action_or_input: Caretaker sends POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/{id}/route/ with action=forward.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=forwarded.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can approve forwarded booking request.
action_or_input: VH In-Charge sends POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/{id}/decide/ with action=approve.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=approved.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can reject forwarded booking request.
action_or_input: VH In-Charge sends POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/{id}/decide/ with action=reject and reason.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=rejected.

purpose: Verify Indenter is notified of final booking decision.
preconditions: Booking approved or rejected by VH In-Charge.
expected_result: Notification log record created for booking with decision event.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record telephonic offline booking.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with is_offline=True and booking_source=telephonic.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record walk-in offline booking.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with is_offline=True and booking_source=walk_in.

purpose: Verify offline booking follows same approval routing as online booking.
action_or_input: Caretaker forwards and Incharge approves offline booking.
expected_result: Transitions through Pending -> Forwarded -> Approved succeed identically.

purpose: Verify offline bookings use same room availability check.
action_or_input: Caretaker checks room availability for offline booking dates.
expected_result: Availability query correctly reflects zero available rooms.

purpose: Verify offline bookings are clearly flagged for audit and reporting.
action_or_input: Inspect booking record in database and report view.
expected_result: is_offline is True and booking_source identifies offline type.

purpose: Verify Indenter can request booking modification before arrival.
preconditions: Approved booking exists prior to arrival date.
action_or_input: Indenter sends POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/{id}/modify/ with new dates.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK and booking dates updated.

purpose: Verify Indenter can request booking cancellation before arrival.
preconditions: Approved booking exists prior to arrival.
action_or_input: Indenter sends POST to /api/v1/vh/bookings/{id}/cancel/ with reason.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=cancellation_requested.

purpose: Verify system computes cancellation charges according to stated schedule.
preconditions: Approved booking with daily rate Decimal(500.00).
action_or_input: Request cancellation and check computed charge.
expected_result: Charge percentage and fee computed per schedule.

purpose: Verify 0% charge for cancellation occurring exactly 7 days before arrival.
preconditions: Approved booking with arrival exactly 7 days from today.
expected_result: cancellation_charge_percentage is 0.00.

purpose: Verify 25% charge of one-day rent for cancellation within 7 days before arrival.
preconditions: Approved booking with arrival 3 days from today.
expected_result: cancellation_charge_percentage is 25.00.

purpose: Verify 50% charge of one-day rent for same-day cancellation or no-show.
action_or_input: Indenter submits cancellation request on arrival date.
expected_result: cancellation_charge_percentage is 50.00.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can review pending cancellation requests.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK containing cancellation request.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can confirm cancellation request.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=cancelled.

purpose: Verify billing information adjusted according to confirmed modification outcome.
preconditions: Booking duration modified from 2 days to 4 days.
expected_result: Bill room rent reflects 4 days instead of 2 days.

purpose: Verify billing information reflects applicable cancellation charge.
expected_result: Bill total equals 25% of one-day room rent with cancellation line item.

purpose: Verify rooms can be allotted only after booking is approved.
action_or_input: Caretaker attempts to allot room to pending booking.
expected_result: HTTP 409 Conflict / 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify Single occupancy records are supported in room allotment.
expected_result: RoomAllotment record created with occupancy_type=single.

purpose: Verify Double occupancy records are supported in room allotment.
expected_result: RoomAllotment record created with occupancy_type=double.

purpose: Verify Suite room records are supported in VHMS.
expected_result: Room successfully created and queried with room_type=suite.

purpose: Verify Non-suite room records are supported in VHMS.
expected_result: Room successfully created and queried with room_type=non_suite.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record guest check-in time.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, status=checked_in, checkin_time is recorded.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record guest check-out time.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, status=checked_out, checkout_time is recorded.

purpose: Verify system generates alert for expected guests who do not check in.
preconditions: Approved booking whose arrival date/time has passed with no check-in.
action_or_input: Evaluate no-show check via service or task.
expected_result: StayAlert record created with alert_type=no_show.

purpose: Verify system generates alert for guests overstaying beyond approved duration.
preconditions: Checked-in booking whose departure date has passed without checkout.
action_or_input: Evaluate overstay check via service or task.
expected_result: StayAlert record created with alert_type=overstay.

purpose: Verify VHMS classifies visitors into categories A, B, C, D.
preconditions: Tariff configuration and bookings support categories A, B, C, D.
action_or_input: Create bookings with visitor_category A, B, C, D.
expected_result: All four categories valid; invalid category rejected.

purpose: Verify system maintains category-specific tariffs.
preconditions: Tariff configs created for Category A and Category B.
expected_result: Tariff rates match configured category-specific amounts.

purpose: Verify system maintains occupancy-specific tariffs (single vs double).
preconditions: Tariff configs created for single and double occupancy.
expected_result: Single and double occupancy return their distinct rates.

purpose: Verify system records effective-from dates for tariffs.
expected_result: TariffConfig persisted with recorded effective_from date.

purpose: Verify system automatically selects applicable tariff during billing.
action_or_input: Generate bill for booking with category A and single occupancy.
expected_result: Bill calculates room rent using latest effective tariff active on arrival date.

purpose: Verify tariff changes do not affect already generated historical bills.
action_or_input: New tariff config created with rate 800.00.
expected_result: Existing finalized bill amount remains unchanged at 500.00.

purpose: Verify meal bookings are permitted only for guests staying in VH.
action_or_input: Attempt to book meal for booking in pending or cancelled state.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify system supports full-day meal option.
expected_result: MealBooking created with meal_option=full_day.

purpose: Verify system supports individual meal options.
action_or_input: Book meal with meal_option=individual and individual_type=breakfast.
expected_result: MealBooking created with meal_option=individual.

purpose: Verify system supports add-on meal options.
action_or_input: Book meal with meal_option=add_on and add_on_type=tea.
expected_result: MealBooking created with meal_option=add_on.

purpose: Verify individual meal options restricted to Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner.
action_or_input: Attempt to book individual meal with type=midnight_snack.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify add-on meal options restricted to Tea and Milk.
action_or_input: Attempt to book add-on meal with type=coffee.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify meal booking must fall within guest stay duration.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify recorded meal bookings are reflected in VHMS billing.
expected_result: Bill meal_charge_total equals sum of meal bookings and line items exist.

purpose: Verify system generates bills based on room rent.
preconditions: 2-day stay in room with 500.00 daily rate.
expected_result: Bill contains room_rent_total of 1000.00.

purpose: Verify system generates bills based on meal consumption.
expected_result: Bill includes meal_charge_total of 350.00.

purpose: Verify system generates bills based on cancellation charges.
preconditions: Cancelled booking with 25% charge of 500.00 rent.
expected_result: Bill includes cancellation_charge_total of 125.00.

purpose: Verify billing responsibility is recorded on generated bill.
expected_result: Bill instance has billing_responsibility=project.

purpose: Verify bills are treated as settled offline in cash.
expected_result: BillSettlement created with payment_mode=offline_cash.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record offline bill settlement information.
action_or_input: POST to /api/v1/vh/bills/{id}/settle/ with amount_paid and receipt_number.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, bill status=settled, settlement record stored.

purpose: Verify Caretaker records guest bill verification during checkout.
expected_result: Bill verified_by and verified_at recorded upon checkout.

purpose: Verify billing records are maintained as immutable for audit.
action_or_input: Attempt to alter line item or total on settled bill.
expected_result: Refusal or error; settled bill remains unaltered.

purpose: Verify Caretaker maintains VH inventory records.
expected_result: HTTP 200 / 201 with inventory items returned and created.

purpose: Verify support for items like linen, utensils, consumables.
preconditions: Items created in categories linen, utensils, consumables.
expected_result: Categories linen, utensils, and consumables recognized and stored.

purpose: Verify system records current quantity for each inventory item.
expected_result: Non-negative integer quantity persisted accurately.

purpose: Verify system records minimum threshold level for inventory items.
expected_result: Minimum threshold value 15 persisted.

purpose: Verify alert generated when current quantity falls below minimum threshold.
expected_result: is_threshold_alert becomes True.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge reviews replenishment requirements.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with pending replenishment request.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge approves replenishment requirements.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, status=approved, approved_by recorded.

purpose: Verify notification triggered for booking submission.
expected_result: BookingNotificationLog entry created for booking_submission.

purpose: Verify notification triggered for booking approval or rejection.
expected_result: BookingNotificationLog entry created for booking_decision.

purpose: Verify notification triggered for booking modification or cancellation.
expected_result: BookingNotificationLog entry created for booking_cancellation.

purpose: Verify system triggers notifications for check-in and check-out reminders.
preconditions: Scheduled task runs for upcoming arrivals.
expected_result: Reminder notification logs generated for expected guests.

purpose: Verify system triggers notification for inventory threshold alerts.
expected_result: Inventory threshold alert notification dispatched.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can generate or view booking summary reports.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with aggregated booking counts by status.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can generate or view category-wise occupancy reports.
preconditions: Occupancies recorded across categories A, B.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with occupancy breakdown by category.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can generate revenue and billing summary report.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with total revenue and settled amount.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can generate inventory usage report.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with item usage and stock levels.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can generate daily occupancy report.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with occupied rooms for date.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can generate upcoming arrivals and departures report.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK listing upcoming check-ins and check-outs.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can generate pending approval report.
preconditions: Bookings in pending and forwarded states exist.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with pending requisitions list.

purpose: Verify Caretaker can generate no-show and overstay exception logs.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK listing recorded no-show and overstay alerts.

purpose: Verify VHMS maintains exactly one active Caretaker at a time.
expected_result: Previous Caretaker is deactivated; exactly 1 active Caretaker exists.

purpose: Verify VHMS maintains exactly one active VH In-Charge at a time.
expected_result: Previous In-Charge is deactivated; exactly 1 active In-Charge exists.

purpose: Verify operational role assignments have time bounds (valid_from, valid_to).
preconditions: Role reassignment requested with time bounds.
action_or_input: POST to /api/v1/vh/roles/reassign/ with valid_from and valid_to.
expected_result: OperationalRoleHolder saved with time bounds.

purpose: Verify operational role reassignment takes effect immediately.
action_or_input: Check active role holder immediately following reassignment call.
expected_result: New user_id is immediately active role holder.

purpose: Verify pending records transferred to newly assigned role holder.
preconditions: Pending bookings exist awaiting Caretaker review.
expected_result: Pending records visible and manageable by new Caretaker.

purpose: Verify ongoing active stay records transferred to newly assigned role holder.
preconditions: Checked-in guests exist under previous Caretaker.
expected_result: Ongoing stay records managed and checkouts executed by new Caretaker.

purpose: Verify auditability of booking records across lifecycle changes.
preconditions: Booking changes state from pending to approved.
action_or_input: Inspect audit history or notification logs.
expected_result: State transitions and timestamps preserved for audit.

purpose: Verify unambiguous tariff selection based on category, occupancy, and date.
preconditions: Tariffs configured with distinct category and occupancy keys.
action_or_input: Query tariff for category B, double occupancy.
expected_result: Unique exact tariff record returned without ambiguity.

purpose: Verify role boundaries are enforced strictly against unauthorized actions.
action_or_input: Indenter attempts to route or approve booking.
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden refusal.

purpose: Verify exclusion of dynamic pricing or discounts beyond approved tariffs.
action_or_input: Bill generated strictly according to standard daily rate without discount fields.
expected_result: Bill contains no unauthorized discount parameters.
